newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ M-3 fell 2.0 pct in July, PSC rose 0.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: NZ M-3 fell 2.0 pct in July, PSC rose 0.2 pct.

text.p: New Zealand seasonally adjusted M-3 money supply fell by 2.0 percent in July while private sector credit rose 0.2 percent, the Reserve Bank said on Thursday.
M3 rose 1.6 percent in June and fell 0.1 percent in July 1995 while private sector credit rose by 1.1 percent and 0.7 percent in the same comparative months, respectively.
M3 rose 15.0 percent in the year to July, down from 17.2 percent in the June year but still up from an annual 9.0 percent in the July 1995 year.
Private sector credit also gained 15.0 percent in the July year, down from 15.7 percent in the year to June but up from 11.9 percent in the July 1995 year.
